description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Change Protection: Contexts can now be set to Protected or Read-only. Aptakube then blocks anything that changes the cluster or runs a command in it (create, edit, delete, scale, restart, et.). Protected Contexts can be temporarily unlocked.
- Contexts: You can now give each context an icon, a color, tags and Change Protection from within Aptakube.
- Contexts: A context's color shows on its avatar, as a dot in the Context column, in the Command Palette and detail headers, and on the dialogs and shell tabs of that context
- Navigation: Added G then key shortcuts to jump to the most used views, like G P for Pods, G D for Deployments and G H for Helm Releases. The full list is in Keyboard Shortcuts
- Navigation: Added Cmd+O (Ctrl+O) to go to the Context Selector
- Command Palette: Added common actions: New Tab, New Window, Create Resource, Open in Terminal, Zoom, Theme, Preferences, Keyboard Shortcuts and Check for Updates
💎 Improvements
- Zoom: Ctrl+Wheel now zooms in and out on Windows and Linux
- Revisions: The current revision of a Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet now has a Current tag, and Rollback is disabled for it
- ConfigMaps: Values scroll with the mouse wheel without clicking them first. On every view with an editor, a scroll that starts on the page now keeps scrolling the page
🐞 Fixes
- Revisions: Fixed Rollback being disabled for the previous revision during a stuck rollout
- Gateway API: Fixed the Matching Pods list of HTTPRoutes
- Argo Rollouts: Fixed completed steps being white text in the light theme
